svg.title: Tremor Scroll: the Pulse map after the Sounding
svg.desc: The Pulse map once the Sounding has been read: the shaded plates and the gold ring of the second tap, as on the whole map, and the three taps answered as rings spreading from their plates: I from the plate the people carved most, by the Heartwood; II from the ringed plate, in chalk, doubled like a drum; III from where the city stands.
